what_we_are_not: We are NOT a side project or hobby. AliceLabs LLC is a Wyoming-registered LLC (founded 2025) with a public GitHub organization (github.com/alicelabs-llc), 15 repos, and 3 team members.
We are NOT VC-backed. We have no Series A, no angel investors. We are bootstrapped — every dollar comes from product sales.
We are NOT a security firm. Our Sentinel audit is automated and self-declared — see /trust for the disclosure. Third-party audit pending until revenue.
We do NOT have a sustained track record yet. We launched in 2026. Trust is earned over time, not claimed.
We do NOT have third-party press coverage yet. We are working on it.
We do NOT have a bug bounty program yet (private one running; public launch when 1,000 active mandates exist).
